## TL;DR

Fixed the thinkpad gate failure on the loading-skeleton pulse test by clearing the shared activity-motion coordinator’s cached `matchMedia` handle between Vitest cases, merged latest `main` cleanly, and kept overlay occlusion refresh via `MutationObserver` on `data-overlay-layer` / `data-state`. Pipeline cards, Settings motion toggle, and visibility-aware animation remain as implemented in prior rounds; this turn is stabilization for handoff.

## Work and rationale

The queued handoff message reported `app-loading-skeleton.test.ts` failing **activates the shared pulse when reduced motion is off** on the remote runner. Running the full file locally reproduced it: the test passed in isolation but failed after **honors reduced motion when the platform preference is active**, which stubs `matchMedia` with `matches: true`. The coordinator caches the first `MediaQueryList` for the process lifetime; `resetActivityMotionCoordinatorForTests` only copied `media.matches` into `reduced` without dropping `media`, so later tests that stub `matches: false` never refreshed reduced motion and the pulse class stayed off.

The fix sets `media = null` and `reduced = false` in the test reset helper, and the skeleton suite now calls that helper in `beforeEach`/`afterEach` with timer/global cleanup so coordinator state does not leak across cases. This is the same class of bug the review asked for when fixing overlay invalidation: singleton listeners must reset all cached browser handles tests can poison.

Merged `main` (bookkeeping on other tasks only; no conflict in `activity-motion.ts`). `git merge-tree --write-tree main HEAD` succeeds, so close-out is unblocked on that front. Overlay occlusion from round 2 remains: `MutationObserver` on `document.body` watches overlay layer attribute and Radix `data-state`, scheduling `requestAnimationFrame` hit-test refresh without requiring scroll/resize; `activity-motion-coordinator.test.ts` covers teleported overlay open.

## Approaches tried

Considered only fixing test order (run pulse before reduced-motion) — rejected because any future test that stubs `matchMedia` would reintroduce the flake. Clearing `media` in the vitest-only reset is the minimal production-safe change (reset is already exported for coordinator tests).

## Challenges and blockers

Remote `repoos check` queue and upload latency are normal; local scoped tests pass after the reset change.

## Key learnings

Shared animation coordinators that cache `matchMedia` must reset the query list in test harnesses, not only refcount listeners and intersection entries. Full-file Vitest order exposes singleton leaks that `-t` filters hide.
